statement.p: (a) Find a vector \vec n perpendicular to the plane z = 7 x + 8 y. \vec n =
(b) Find a vector \vec v parallel to the plane.

static.solution:
(a) Writing the plane in the form 7 x + 8 y - z = 0 shows that a normal vector is \vec n = 7 \vec i + 8 \vec j - \vec k. Any multiple of this vector is also a correct answer.
(b) Any vector perpendicular to \vec n is parallel to the plane, so one possible answer is \vec v= 8\vec i - 7\vec j. Many other answers are possible.
